blocks.text: Pain rarely arrives at a convenient time. A sore back can slow down a workday, aching muscles can get in the way of exercise, and even simple body pain can make it harder to focus, move, and make decisions. That is why, when body pain strikes, speed matters. Alaxan, a familiar name in pain relief among Filipino consumers, is taking that idea further with Alaxan XTRA, a reformulated version designed to work up to 3x faster absorption vs. the previous formulation of Alaxan FR.
